title: What is the best Ai to turn images of low poly objects into low poly 3d objects, with the poly count as low as possible?
author: Odd_Judgment_3513
selftext: Currently I am using hunyuan, but sometimes it sucks, is there a better model for low poly models?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
AI isn't good at making low poly. You can generate models that look low poly but the poly count and topology are going to be bad regardless.

You probably will have to look into auto/manual re-topo approaches

replies.author: Large-Explorer-8532
replies.body: That was true a while ago, you should check blender-mcp or [3d-agent.com](http://3d-agent.com)

replies.author: Large-Explorer-8532
replies.body: It is just the start, LLMs are starting now to understand spacial behavirous. Those assets are pretty good considering the complexity and the good topology.

replies.author: Large-Explorer-8532
replies.body: Trellis still uses thousands of vertices

comments.author: Apart_Athlete_8651
comments.body: You could take already existing low-poly 3D models, like free starter models and re-texture them in Meshy.  I'm not sure if it changes the poly count but it doesn't look like it from what I can tell.
